messages:
anna-partnerships: Quick sanity thread before we push the marketplace uploads. Need final AMI/Container IDs, EU trial flag decision, and blurb approval. Plan is to start uploads at 09:00 PT tomorrow.

sanjay-eng: Containers: gcr.io/redwood/marketplace:v2026-03-25 (multi-arch) and ghcr.io/redwood/marketplace:stable-2026. AMI (x86_64): ami-0123abcd4567ef890. All smoke tests green.

marta-cloud: Azure tenant GUID and AWS staging account are ready. For region controls: set trial_allowed_regions=["eu-west-1","eu-central-1"] if you want EU-only trials.

olivia-legal: Recommend EU-only trial flag for the trial SKU because of the anchor customer's data residency ask. Also removed "no refunds" language from the blurb. Uploaded addendum with SI carveouts.

rhea-marketing: Draft blurb: "Redwood Inference  production-grade LLM inference  secure, low-latency, cost-aware." Using placeholder hero until legal signs off.

artifact-bot: artifact-bundle v1.6.3 staged at s3://marketplace-artifacts/redwood/v1.6.3 at 2026-03-25T16:42:10Z :package:

anna-partnerships: OK everyone  I'll set trial_allowed_regions to EU-only for the trial SKU and proceed with uploads tomorrow unless any objections. Please react with :thumbsup: when your item is cleared.

sanjay-eng: :thumbsup: containers + AMI verified.

marta-cloud: :thumbsup: tenant & accounts good.

olivia-legal: :thumbsup: addendum accepted.

rhea-marketing: :thumbsup: placeholder blurb approved.

anna-partnerships: Thanks  final upload scheduled 09:00 PT tomorrow. If anything blocks, DM me.
